method: Direct include of complete production io_pgtable.c with host page/PTE stubs and tracked ownership; no copied destructor implementation.
actual_execution: host executable only; no kernel runtime, RTL, FPGA or board execution
coverage: actual production map/unmap/lookup followed by empty table destructor
limits: Host allocator models page ownership, not kernel DMA/locking/memory-order hardware.
Only accepted plain Sv39 table topology; no invalid page-table or huge-page mutation concurrency claim.
